title: Wait at Bellatrix Major Belt beside Node Gamma station for whatever regrows (thorium, palladium, iridium, carbon)
note: On trial 2026-11-15: every deposit of this belt read 0, picked clean by other pilots. The belt lies in the station's own system: no jump. Two questions: what a ship costs here per hour, and whether thorium (stations bid 240 cr) or palladium (371 cr at Node Gamma) comes back for us. Result of the trial with five ships, 2026-11-15 17:37 to 18:50 UTC: two runs of 45 minutes cost 0 cr (no trip to the station was needed) and mined 48 and 0 units; every deposit still read 0 at 18:33 UTC. One ship stays as the watch; the census history records the deposits every half hour.
